newsitem.title: USA: NRC sets $50,000 fine for Southern Nuclear.
newsitem.headline: NRC sets $50,000 fine for Southern Nuclear.

text.p: Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Thursday it proposed a $50,000 civil penalty against Southern Nuclear Operating Co for an alleged failure to comply with safety requirements at the Farley nuclear power plant.
NRC said the proposed penalty was the result of alleged noncompliance with federal requirements related to fire protection at the plant, located near Columbia, Ala.
Southern Nuclear has 30 days to either pay the fine or protest it, NRC said in a statement.

The violation of the fire protection plan involved three examples where Farley staff failed to assure that one-hour fire barriers were installed on electrical cables associated with systems required for the shutdown of the plant, NRC said.
While there was no fire, the degraded fire barriers raised the vulnerability of safety-related equipment to potential fire hazard or damage, it said.
